title: Year 1: accepted results
introduction: Economic 51 (+2), Social 58 (+0), Environmental 47.5 (+1). Cash $9,000,000 is saved. These are illustrative results.

cards.title: Public budget
cards.text: $100,000 of public upkeep was paid. Private harvest is not public income.

cards.title: Harvest and weather
cards.text: West field output decreased under the saved dry-season response. This is an authored scenario, not a forecast.

cards.title: Next year's starting condition
cards.text: Funded public repair improves next year's starting condition; it does not reverse this year's harvest loss.
